summary.zh: 用变分推断训练带潜变量的生成模型，后来成为潜空间扩散模型的压缩器。
summary.en: Trains latent-variable generative models with variational inference; later became the compressor behind latent diffusion.

summary.zh: 生成器与判别器对抗训练，开启了高质量图像生成的一个时代。
summary.en: A generator and a discriminator trained against each other, opening an era of high-quality image generation.

summary.zh: 把扩散过程做成实用的图像生成方法，质量追平并超越 GAN，成为图像/视频生成的主流范式。
summary.en: Turned diffusion into a practical image generator that matched and then beat GANs; now the dominant paradigm for image and video.

summary.zh: 不需要额外分类器即可做条件引导，几乎所有文生图模型都在用。
summary.en: Conditional guidance without a separate classifier; used by almost every text-to-image model.

summary.zh: 用回归速度场的方式训练连续流模型，成为新一代图像/视频模型的训练目标之一。
summary.en: Trains continuous flow models by regressing a velocity field; a training objective of many new image and video models.

agent_reason.zh: 近期多个图像/视频模型技术报告采用此训练目标，建议挂在『生成范式』下，父节点 DDPM。
agent_reason.en: Several recent image and video model reports adopt this training objective. Suggest placing it under Generative Paradigms with DDPM as parent.

summary.zh: 纯注意力架构，几乎所有现代生成模型的共同祖先。
summary.en: The pure-attention architecture: common ancestor of nearly all modern generative models.

summary.zh: 发现损失随参数、数据、算力呈幂律下降，直接推动了大模型路线。
summary.en: Loss falls as a power law in parameters, data and compute; this pushed the field toward large models.

summary.zh: 稀疏专家混合，让参数量与单次计算量解耦。
summary.en: Sparse mixture-of-experts decouples parameter count from per-token compute.

summary.zh: 选择性状态空间模型，序列长度上线性复杂度，是 Transformer 的竞争路线之一。
summary.en: Selective state-space model with linear cost in sequence length; a competing route to the Transformer.

agent_reason.zh: 架构路线上有代表性，但主流生成模型采用程度待确认；父节点关系（Transformer）为竞争而非继承，需人工判断。
agent_reason.en: Representative of a new architecture route, but adoption in mainstream generative models is unconfirmed; the parent link (Transformer) is competition rather than inheritance and needs human judgement.

summary.zh: 生成式预训练 + 下游微调，证明了“先预训练再迁移”的路线。
summary.en: Generative pre-training plus fine-tuning showed that pre-train-then-transfer works.

summary.zh: 规模扩大后零样本生成能力明显出现。
summary.en: At larger scale, zero-shot generation ability clearly emerged.

summary.zh: 175B 参数，展示了上下文学习（few-shot in-context learning）。
summary.en: 175B parameters; demonstrated few-shot in-context learning.

summary.zh: 对话式产品形态让生成式 AI 进入大众视野。
summary.en: The chat product brought generative AI to the general public.

summary.zh: 高质量开放权重模型，催生了开源大模型生态。
summary.en: High-quality open-weight models that kicked off the open LLM ecosystem.

summary.zh: 在大量专业考试和基准上大幅提升，支持图像输入。
summary.en: Large gains on professional exams and benchmarks; accepts image input.

summary.zh: 开放权重的 MoE 模型，让稀疏专家路线在开源界普及。
summary.en: An open-weight MoE model that popularised sparse experts in open source.

summary.zh: 从人类比较偏好中学习奖励函数，RLHF 的源头。
summary.en: Learns a reward function from human comparisons: the origin of RLHF.

summary.zh: 把 RLHF 用在语言模型上，小模型的指令遵循胜过大得多的基础模型。
summary.en: Applied RLHF to language models; a small aligned model beat a much larger base model at following instructions.

summary.zh: 用一组原则让模型自我批评与修正，减少对人工标注的依赖（RLAIF）。
summary.en: A set of principles lets the model critique and revise itself, reducing reliance on human labels (RLAIF).

summary.zh: 不训练奖励模型、直接用偏好数据优化策略，大幅简化对齐流程。
summary.en: Optimises the policy directly on preference data without a reward model, greatly simplifying alignment.

summary.zh: 让模型先写出中间推理步骤，显著提升数学与逻辑题表现。
summary.en: Having the model write intermediate steps sharply improves math and logic performance.

summary.zh: 多次采样推理路径后投票，进一步提升准确率。
summary.en: Sample several reasoning paths and vote, further improving accuracy.

summary.zh: 组内相对策略优化，省掉价值网络，后来成为推理模型 RL 的常用算法。
summary.en: Group-relative policy optimisation drops the value network; later a standard RL algorithm for reasoning models.

summary.zh: 用强化学习训练长思维链，推理时算力越多效果越好。
summary.en: Long chains of thought trained with RL: more inference-time compute, better results.

summary.zh: 开放权重的推理模型，公开了以纯 RL 激发推理能力的做法。
summary.en: An open-weight reasoning model that published how pure RL can elicit reasoning.

summary.zh: 风格化生成器，高分辨率人脸生成达到以假乱真。
summary.en: Style-based generator; high-resolution faces became indistinguishable from photos.

summary.zh: 首个引起广泛关注的大规模文生图模型。
summary.en: The first large text-to-image model to draw wide attention.

summary.zh: 在 VAE 压缩后的潜空间里做扩散，计算量大降，Stable Diffusion 的基础。
summary.en: Diffusion in a VAE-compressed latent space cuts compute dramatically; the basis of Stable Diffusion.

summary.zh: CLIP 潜变量 + 扩散解码，文生图质量大跃进。
summary.en: CLIP latents plus a diffusion decoder: a big jump in text-to-image quality.

summary.zh: 开放权重的文生图模型，可在消费级显卡运行，引爆社区生态。
summary.en: Open-weight text-to-image model that runs on consumer GPUs and ignited a community ecosystem.

summary.zh: 用 Transformer 替代 U-Net 作扩散主干，扩展性更好，后来被视频模型采用。
summary.en: Replaces the U-Net with a Transformer backbone for better scaling; later adopted by video models.

summary.zh: 用边缘、姿态等条件精确控制生成结构。
summary.en: Precise structural control of generation using edges, poses and other conditions.

summary.zh: 把扩散模型扩展到视频生成。
summary.en: Extended diffusion models to video generation.

summary.zh: 长时长、高一致性的文生视频，展示了 DiT 在视频上的扩展性。
summary.en: Long, highly consistent text-to-video, showing DiT scales to video.

summary.zh: 自回归原始波形生成，语音合成自然度大幅提升。
summary.en: Autoregressive raw-waveform generation; a big leap in speech naturalness.

summary.zh: 把音频离散成 token 用语言模型生成，语音和钢琴续写连贯。
summary.en: Discretises audio into tokens and generates with a language model; coherent speech and piano continuation.

summary.zh: 由文本描述生成高保真音乐。
summary.en: Generates high-fidelity music from text descriptions.

summary.zh: 图文对比学习，成为文生图和视觉语言模型的通用对齐桥梁。
summary.en: Contrastive image-text learning; the common alignment bridge for text-to-image and vision-language models.

summary.zh: 视觉语言模型，少样本即可完成图文任务。
summary.en: A vision-language model that handles image-text tasks from a few examples.

summary.zh: 原生多模态训练的大模型系列。
summary.en: Model family trained natively multimodal.

summary.zh: 文本、图像、音频端到端统一，实时语音对话。
summary.en: Text, image and audio unified end to end; real-time voice conversation.

summary.zh: 生成时检索外部知识，减少幻觉、可接入私有数据。
summary.en: Retrieves external knowledge at generation time, reducing hallucination and connecting private data.

summary.zh: 推理与行动交替进行，现代 Agent 循环的原型。
summary.en: Interleaves reasoning and acting: the prototype of the modern agent loop.

summary.zh: 模型自学何时调用 API 工具。
summary.en: The model teaches itself when to call API tools.

summary.zh: 连接模型与工具/数据源的开放协议，被多家厂商采用。
summary.en: An open protocol connecting models to tools and data sources, adopted by many vendors.

summary.zh: 低秩适配，只训练极少参数即可微调大模型。
summary.en: Low-rank adaptation: fine-tune large models by training very few parameters.

summary.zh: IO 感知的精确注意力实现，显著提速省显存。
summary.en: IO-aware exact attention; much faster and lighter on memory.

summary.zh: 小模型起草、大模型验证，不改输出分布即可加速推理。
summary.en: A small model drafts and a large model verifies, speeding inference without changing outputs.

summary.zh: 4-bit 量化 + LoRA，单卡可微调数十亿参数模型。
summary.en: 4-bit quantisation plus LoRA: fine-tune multi-billion-parameter models on a single GPU.

summary.zh: 671B 参数 MoE 模型。技术报告称在 2048 张 H800 上训练，总计约 278.8 万 GPU 小时。受出口管制的硬件条件，倒逼出 FP8 训练、通信优化等工程创新。
summary.en: 671B-parameter MoE. The report says it trained on 2,048 H800s for about 2.788M GPU hours; export-controlled hardware pushed innovations such as FP8 training and communication optimisation.

summary.zh: 通过 Discord 提供的文生图服务，让大众第一次大规模用上图像生成。
summary.en: Text-to-image via Discord; the first time the public used image generation at scale.

summary.zh: IDE 里的代码补全助手，第一个被开发者大规模使用的生成式 AI 产品。
summary.en: Code completion in the IDE; the first generative AI product used by developers at scale.

summary.zh: 生成式 AI 进入办公套件，企业级规模化付费部署的标志之一。
summary.en: Generative AI enters the office suite; a marker of paid enterprise deployment at scale.

summary.zh: 用扩散模型预测蛋白质与 DNA、RNA、小分子等的复合结构，生成式方法进入结构生物学核心。
summary.en: Uses diffusion to predict complexes of proteins with DNA, RNA and small molecules; generative methods reach the core of structural biology.

title.zh: RT-2 视觉-语言-动作模型

summary.zh: 把机器人动作当作 token 让视觉语言模型直接输出，网络知识迁移到机器人控制。
summary.en: Treats robot actions as tokens output directly by a vision-language model, transferring web knowledge to robot control.

summary.zh: 视觉语言模型 + flow matching 动作生成，一个模型完成叠衣服、收拾桌子等多种灵巧操作。
summary.en: A VLM plus flow-matching action generation; one model folds laundry, clears tables and more.

summary.zh: 57 个学科的多选题基准，曾是衡量大模型知识水平的通用标尺。
summary.en: Multiple-choice benchmark across 57 subjects; long the standard yardstick of model knowledge.

summary.zh: 按单元测试是否通过来评测代码生成。
summary.en: Evaluates code generation by whether unit tests pass.

summary.zh: 让用户盲测两个模型的回答并投票，用 Elo 排名，从“考试分数”转向“人类偏好”。
summary.en: Users blind-compare two models and vote, ranked by Elo: from exam scores to human preference.

summary.zh: 用真实 GitHub issue 评测模型修复代码库的能力，Agent 评测的代表。
summary.en: Evaluates fixing real GitHub issues in real codebases; a flagship agent benchmark.

summary.zh: 像操作系统分页一样管理 KV 缓存，推理吞吐大幅提升，成为开源推理服务的主流引擎。
summary.en: Manages the KV cache like OS paging; much higher throughput, now the mainstream open-source serving engine.

summary.zh: 千万级标注图像数据集，为深度学习的突破提供了“考场”和“燃料”。
summary.en: A labeled image dataset at the ten-million scale; the test bed and fuel for the deep learning breakthrough.

summary.zh: 825GB 开放英文语料，开源大模型预训练的早期基础。
summary.en: 825GB open English corpus; an early foundation for open LLM pre-training.

summary.zh: 58 亿图文对的开放数据集，Stable Diffusion 等开源图像模型的训练数据来源。
summary.en: 5.8 billion open image-text pairs; training data for Stable Diffusion and other open image models.

summary.zh: 发现给定算力下参数量和训练 token 数应同比例扩大，此前的大模型普遍“数据不足”。数据量从此成为核心变量。
summary.en: For a fixed compute budget, parameters and training tokens should scale together; earlier models were under-trained on data. Data became a core variable.

title.zh: 高质量文本会被用完吗
title.en: Will We Run Out of Data?

summary.zh: 估计按当前趋势，高质量公开文本数据将在数年内被耗尽，即“数据墙”问题。
summary.en: Estimates that at current trends high-quality public text will be exhausted within years: the data wall.

summary.zh: 让模型自己生成指令数据来微调自己，合成数据路线的起点之一。
summary.en: The model generates its own instruction data to fine-tune itself; an origin of the synthetic data route.

summary.zh: 用“教科书质量”的合成数据训练小模型，代码能力超过大得多的模型，说明数据质量可以替代规模。
summary.en: A small model trained on textbook-quality synthetic data beats far larger models at code: data quality can substitute for scale.

title.zh: 《纽约时报》起诉 OpenAI 与微软
title.en: New York Times sues OpenAI and Microsoft

summary.zh: 指控未经授权使用其文章训练模型，训练数据的版权与授权问题进入诉讼阶段。
summary.en: Alleges unauthorised use of its articles for training; training-data copyright enters litigation.

summary.zh: 15 万亿 token 的开放网页语料，公开了完整的清洗与去重流程。
summary.en: 15-trillion-token open web corpus with a fully published cleaning and deduplication pipeline.

summary.zh: 工业级深度学习框架开源，深度学习工程化普及。
summary.en: An industrial-grade framework goes open source; deep learning engineering spreads.

summary.zh: 动态图、Python 优先的框架，后来成为研究和大模型训练的事实标准。
summary.en: Dynamic graphs, Python first; became the de facto standard for research and LLM training.

summary.zh: 用 FP16 计算、FP32 保存权重，训练速度和显存效率大幅提升，配合 Tensor Core 使用。
summary.en: Compute in FP16 while keeping FP32 weights; big gains in speed and memory, paired with Tensor Cores.

summary.zh: 把单层矩阵切到多张 GPU 上，训练超出单卡显存的大模型。
summary.en: Splits each layer's matrices across GPUs to train models larger than one GPU's memory.

summary.zh: 把优化器状态、梯度、参数分片到各卡，消除数据并行的显存冗余。
summary.en: Shards optimiser states, gradients and parameters across GPUs, removing data-parallel memory redundancy.

summary.zh: 用 Python 写高性能 GPU 内核，降低了绕开手写 CUDA 的门槛。
summary.en: Write high-performance GPU kernels in Python, lowering the bar versus hand-written CUDA.

summary.zh: 8 卡 NVLink 互联的一体化深度学习服务器，把“GPU 集群”产品化。
summary.en: An integrated 8-GPU NVLink server that productised the GPU cluster.

summary.zh: InfiniBand 高速网络并入 GPU 厂商，集群互联成为 AI 算力的关键一环（2019 年宣布，2020 年完成）。
summary.en: InfiniBand networking joins the GPU vendor; cluster interconnect becomes central to AI compute (announced 2019, closed 2020).

title.zh: Azure 为 OpenAI 建的超级计算机

summary.zh: 万卡级 GPU 集群专为大模型训练而建。GPT-3 论文写明训练使用的是微软提供的 V100 集群。
summary.en: A 10,000-GPU-class cluster built for large-model training. The GPT-3 paper states it trained on a V100 cluster provided by Microsoft.

summary.zh: 约 10 万张 H100 的单一训练集群，标志着训练集群进入十万卡量级。
summary.en: A single training cluster of about 100,000 H100s; training clusters reach the 100k scale.

summary.zh: 宣布未来数年投入最高 5000 亿美元建设 AI 数据中心，算力竞争进入国家级、千亿美元级。
summary.en: Announced up to $500B over several years for AI data centres; the compute race reaches national, hundred-billion scale.

summary.zh: 让 GPU 可以做通用计算的编程平台，是之后整个深度学习软件栈的地基。
summary.en: The platform that made GPUs programmable for general computing; the foundation of the entire deep learning software stack.

summary.zh: 用两张消费级 GPU 训练的 CNN 赢下 ImageNet，证明了“GPU + 深度学习”的路线。
summary.en: A CNN trained on two consumer GPUs won ImageNet, proving the GPU + deep learning route.

summary.zh: 把 DRAM 堆叠在芯片旁边，带宽远超传统显存，后来成为 AI 加速器的标配。
summary.en: DRAM stacked beside the processor with far higher bandwidth; later standard on every AI accelerator.

summary.zh: 首款数据中心 GPU 同时用上 NVLink 互联、HBM2 和 CoWoS 封装。Transformer 原论文就是在 8 张 P100 上训练的。
summary.en: First data-centre GPU with NVLink, HBM2 and CoWoS packaging together. The original Transformer was trained on 8 P100s.

summary.zh: 专用 AI 芯片（ASIC）路线的代表，证明了 GPU 之外的另一条路。
summary.en: The flagship of the custom AI chip (ASIC) route; proof there is a path beyond GPUs.

summary.zh: 引入专门做矩阵乘的 Tensor Core，深度学习训练吞吐大幅提升。
summary.en: Introduced Tensor Cores dedicated to matrix multiply; a big jump in training throughput.

summary.zh: 支持 TF32 / 稀疏加速，成为 2020–2023 年大模型训练的主力卡。
summary.en: TF32 and sparsity acceleration; the workhorse of large-model training in 2020–2023.

summary.zh: 针对 Transformer 加入 FP8 支持，成为生成式 AI 爆发期最紧缺的硬件。
summary.en: Added FP8 for Transformers; the scarcest hardware of the generative AI boom.

title.zh: 美国对华先进芯片出口管制
title.en: US Export Controls on Advanced Chips to China

summary.zh: 限制向中国出口高端 AI 芯片和制造设备，此后多次加码。直接改变了全球算力的分布。
summary.en: Restricted exports of high-end AI chips and chipmaking equipment to China, tightened several times since; reshaped the global distribution of compute.

summary.zh: 为符合出口规则而降低互联带宽的 H100 版本，后来也被纳入管制。
summary.en: An H100 with reduced interconnect bandwidth to meet export rules; later also restricted.

summary.zh: 72 卡整机柜互联、液冷，算力单位从“一张卡”变成“一个机柜”。
summary.en: 72 GPUs linked as one liquid-cooled rack: the unit of compute shifts from a card to a rack.

summary.zh: 主要厂商表示 2024 年及 2025 年大部分 HBM 产能已被订满，内存成为算力瓶颈之一。
summary.en: Major makers said HBM capacity for 2024 and most of 2025 was fully booked; memory became a compute bottleneck.

summary.zh: 把计算芯片和 HBM 并排封装在硅中介层上，是现代 AI 加速器能做出来的前提。
summary.en: Places compute dies and HBM side by side on a silicon interposer; a prerequisite for modern AI accelerators.

summary.zh: 极紫外光刻进入大规模量产，7nm 以下先进制程的基础。全球只有 ASML 能造 EUV 光刻机。
summary.en: Extreme-ultraviolet lithography enters high-volume manufacturing, the basis of sub-7nm nodes. Only ASML builds EUV machines.

summary.zh: 生成式 AI 需求爆发后，先进封装产能成为限制 GPU 出货的主要瓶颈之一，台积电持续扩产。
summary.en: After the generative AI surge, advanced packaging capacity became a main limit on GPU shipments; TSMC keeps expanding.

title.zh: AI 优化数据中心制冷

summary.zh: 用机器学习调控谷歌数据中心的冷却系统，冷却能耗显著下降。AI 反过来优化自身基础设施的早期例子。
summary.en: Machine learning controls Google's data-centre cooling and cuts cooling energy substantially; an early case of AI optimising its own infrastructure.

title.zh: 新加坡解除数据中心暂停令

summary.zh: 新加坡因电力和土地限制，2019 年起暂停新建数据中心；2022 年 1 月宣布解除，但新项目须满足严格的能效条件。电力约束直接限制算力落地的早期案例。
summary.en: Singapore paused new data centres from 2019 over power and land limits, and lifted it in January 2022 with strict efficiency conditions; an early case of power directly limiting compute.

title.zh: 三哩岛核电站重启协议

summary.zh: 微软签 20 年购电协议，支持重启已关闭的三哩岛 1 号机组，为数据中心供电。科技公司开始直接介入发电侧。
summary.en: Microsoft signed a 20-year power purchase agreement supporting the restart of Unit 1 to supply its data centres; tech firms step into power generation.

title.zh: 科技公司签约小型模块化核反应堆
title.en: Tech Firms Sign Small Modular Reactor Deals

summary.zh: 谷歌和亚马逊相继签约 SMR 项目，目标在 2030 年前后上线。
summary.en: Google and Amazon signed SMR deals targeting operation around 2030.

summary.zh: 2024 年数据中心用电约 415 TWh（全球约 1.5%），预计 2030 年翻倍到约 945 TWh。电力成为 AI 扩张的硬约束。
summary.en: Data centres used about 415 TWh in 2024 (about 1.5% of global electricity), projected to roughly double to about 945 TWh by 2030. Power becomes a hard constraint on AI growth.

title.zh: 乌克兰战争冲击氖气供应

summary.zh: 乌克兰是半导体级氖气（光刻激光器用）的重要产地，战争导致供应中断、价格暴涨。
summary.en: Ukraine is a key source of semiconductor-grade neon for lithography lasers; the war cut supply and spiked prices.

title.zh: 中国对镓、锗实施出口管制
title.en: China Export Controls on Gallium and Germanium

summary.zh: 镓、锗用于化合物半导体、光电器件等，中国是主要产出国。2023 年 7 月宣布、8 月起实施出口许可。
summary.en: Used in compound semiconductors and optoelectronics, with China the main producer. Announced July 2023, licensing from August.

title.zh: 飓风海伦停摆 Spruce Pine 高纯石英
title.en: Hurricane Helene Halts Spruce Pine Quartz

summary.zh: 美国北卡小镇 Spruce Pine 供应全球大部分高纯石英，用来做拉制单晶硅的坩埚。飓风导致两家矿企停产，暴露了芯片供应链的单点依赖。
summary.en: Spruce Pine, North Carolina supplies most of the world's high-purity quartz for silicon-crystal crucibles. The storm shut two mines, exposing a single point of failure in the chip supply chain.

title.zh: 中国对七种中重稀土实施出口管制
title.en: China Controls Seven Medium/Heavy Rare Earths

summary.zh: 钐、钆、铽、镝、镥、钪、钇纳入出口许可管理。中国约占全球稀土精炼的九成。
summary.en: Samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium and yttrium placed under export licensing. China does about 90% of global rare earth refining.

source.zh: 中国商务部 / 海关总署

summary.zh: 允许商用的开放权重模型，开源模型进入企业应用。
summary.en: Open weights licensed for commercial use; open models enter enterprise applications.

summary.zh: Meta 首个 MoE 架构的 Llama 系列，原生多模态。
summary.en: Meta's first MoE Llama family, natively multimodal.

summary.zh: 从 0.6B 到 235B MoE 的开放权重家族，同一模型可切换思考/非思考模式。
summary.en: An open-weight family from 0.6B to 235B MoE; one model can switch between thinking and non-thinking modes.

summary.zh: OpenAI 自 GPT-2 以来首次发布开放权重模型（120B / 20B 推理模型）。
summary.en: OpenAI's first open-weight models since GPT-2 (120B and 20B reasoning models).

summary.zh: 用旋转矩阵编码相对位置，后来成为开源大模型的标准位置编码，也是长上下文外推的基础。
summary.en: Encodes relative position with rotations; became the standard in open LLMs and the basis for context extension.

summary.zh: 商用模型上下文窗口从数千 token 跃升到 10 万，可一次读完一本书。
summary.en: Commercial context windows jump from thousands of tokens to 100K: a whole book in one go.

summary.zh: 上下文窗口达到 100 万 token 量级，可直接处理长视频和整个代码库。
summary.en: Context windows reach about one million tokens, handling long videos and whole codebases directly.

summary.zh: 把推理组织成可回溯的树搜索，而非单条思维链。
summary.en: Organises reasoning as a backtracking tree search rather than a single chain.

summary.zh: 系统研究了推理时多花算力能否替代更大的模型：在部分任务上，推理时算力比参数更划算。
summary.en: Systematically studied whether more inference compute can replace a bigger model: on some tasks it is the better trade.

summary.zh: 推理模型开始在推理过程中自主调用工具（搜索、代码、看图）。
summary.en: Reasoning models begin calling tools (search, code, vision) on their own while reasoning.

summary.zh: 通用推理模型在国际数学奥林匹克题目上达到金牌分数线。
summary.en: General reasoning models reach the gold-medal score on International Mathematical Olympiad problems.

summary.zh: 用几张照片教会模型一个特定主体，个性化生成的开端。
summary.en: Teaches a model a specific subject from a few photos: the start of personalised generation.

summary.zh: 用一句文字指令编辑图片。
summary.en: Edit an image with a single text instruction.

summary.zh: 根据文字实时生成可交互、可行走的 3D 环境，用于训练 Agent。
summary.en: Generates interactive, walkable 3D environments from text in real time, for training agents.

summary.zh: 把整片晶圆做成一颗芯片，走与 GPU 完全不同的路线。
summary.en: An entire wafer as one chip; a route entirely different from GPUs.

summary.zh: 云厂商自研训练芯片，减少对 GPU 的依赖。
summary.en: A cloud provider's in-house training chip, reducing dependence on GPUs.

summary.zh: 与 Gemini 同期发布的训练用 TPU，大规模 Pod 互联。
summary.en: Training TPU released alongside Gemini, with large-scale pod interconnect.

summary.zh: 快速回答与深度推理合并成一个系统，自动路由，取代了此前多个模型的选择。
summary.en: Fast answers and deep reasoning merged into one auto-routing system, replacing the choice among several models.

summary.zh: 带同步音频的视频生成，并以社交 App 形式发布。
summary.en: Video generation with synchronised audio, launched as a social app.

summary.zh: Google 新一代旗舰模型，多项基准领先。
summary.en: Google's next flagship model, leading on many benchmarks.

summary.zh: Anthropic 旗舰模型更新，侧重编程与 Agent 任务。
summary.en: Anthropic flagship update focused on coding and agent tasks.

summary.zh: Anthropic 首批 Mythos 级模型发布。
summary.en: Anthropic's first Mythos-class models are released.

title.zh: 出口管制致模型访问暂停

summary.zh: 为遵守美国商务部出口管制，Anthropic 暂停了 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的访问；管制于 6 月 30 日解除，7 月 1 日恢复访问。出口管制第一次直接作用到模型访问层面。
summary.en: To comply with US Department of Commerce export controls, Anthropic suspended access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5; the controls were lifted on June 30 and access was restored on July 1. The first time export controls acted directly on model access.

summary.zh: CES 2026 发布的六芯片平台（Vera CPU、Rubin GPU、NVLink 6 等），采用 HBM4；7 月确认全面量产并开始向云厂商出货。
summary.en: The six-chip platform unveiled at CES 2026 (Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, NVLink 6 and more) with HBM4; confirmed in full production and shipping to cloud providers in July.

title.zh: 美财长要求英伟达说明先进芯片流入中国
title.en: US Treasury Asks Nvidia About Chips Reaching China

summary.zh: 美国财政部长公开要求英伟达解释其最先进的 AI 芯片是否被明知流入中国。出口管制执行仍在持续收紧。
summary.en: The US Treasury Secretary publicly asked Nvidia to explain whether its most advanced AI chips knowingly reached China. Enforcement of export controls keeps tightening.

summary.zh: 在原朴茨茅斯气体扩散厂旧址规划 10GW AI 园区，配套近等量的天然气发电；OpenAI 签约约 8GW、20 年租约。
summary.en: A 10GW AI campus planned on the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site with nearly matching gas generation; OpenAI signed a 20-year lease for about 8GW.

summary.zh: 由 NextEra 和 Brookfield 牵头，最高 1000 亿美元投资，建设 1.8GW 数据中心并配套 4.6GW 专用电源与储能。
summary.en: Led by NextEra and Brookfield, up to $100B to build a 1.8GW data centre with 4.6GW of dedicated power and storage.

title.zh: 首批吉瓦级 AI 数据中心投运

summary.zh: 预计 2026 年有 5 座 1GW 以上的数据中心上线，分属不同云厂商，单个园区耗电相当于一座核反应堆。
summary.en: Five data centres above 1GW are expected online in 2026, each run by a different hyperscaler; each draws as much power as a nuclear reactor.

title.zh: 中国扩大稀土管制（含域外条款）

summary.zh: 新增五种稀土及相关设备、技术，并对含少量中国来源稀土的境外产品提出许可要求。
summary.en: Five more rare earths plus equipment and technology, and licensing for foreign products containing small amounts of Chinese-origin rare earths.

title.en: October Rules Suspended for a Year

summary.zh: 中美贸易休战后，十月新规暂停至 2026-11-10；四月对七种中重稀土的管制仍然有效。
summary.en: After the US-China trade truce, the October rules were suspended until 2026-11-10; the April controls on seven elements stayed in force.

title.zh: 稀土管制暂停期延长至 2027-01

summary.zh: 原定 11 月 10 日到期的暂停被延长到 2027-01-10。七种中重稀土的出口管制继续有效。
summary.en: The suspension due to end on Nov 10 was extended to 2027-01-10. Controls on the seven medium/heavy rare earths remain in force.

summary.zh: 若不再延长，十月新规将恢复执行。这是一个已知的未来节点，Agent 应在到期前后重点跟踪。
summary.en: Unless extended again, the October rules resume. A known future node the agent should track closely around the deadline.
